name: faqs-10
description: Chat-style FAQ thread with question bubbles and assistant answers, ending with a chat CTA.

files.content:
import { Sparkles, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const thread = [ { q: "Are Designali blocks free, or is it just a trial?", a: "Both exist. Plenty of blocks, icons and logos are free on designali.com, and Designali Pro unlocks the full library of templates and landing pages.", }, { q: "Can my clients use sites I build with Designali templates?", a: "Yes. You can deliver client work built with Designali templates and blocks. You just can't resell the raw files as your own kit.", }, { q: "We already have a design system. Will the blocks clash?", a: "Unlikely. Blocks only use semantic tokens like background, muted and primary, so they pick up your theme as soon as you paste them in.", }, { q: "Can I talk to the person who built them?", a: "Yes. Ali Imam designs and codes every Designali block. Write to hello@designali.com or reach out on X at @designali_com.", }, ] export default function Faqs10() { return (

You asked, we answered

The questions designers and developers ask Designali most, answered straight.

{thread.map((item) => (

{item.q}

{item.a}

))}

Got a question that isn't here?

) }
